# Joseph Breitreiter

> Principal UX Designer, AI at Tricentis. Helping humans and AI understand each other and get stuff done.

Full-stack designer based in Austin, TX. Twenty years across UX, front-end, and back-end. Background in data sensemaking — how users sift through, draw conclusions, and build cases from large volumes of data. Current work focuses on how that task changes when an AI agent is in the loop.

## Case studies

- [AI/ML Visiontype](https://dreamlands.org/case/aiml.html): Long-term product vision imagining what AI/ML could look like five years out.
- [FeatureBase](https://dreamlands.org/case/featurebase.html): New SaaS UI for a realtime bitmap database.
- [Nova Dashboards](https://dreamlands.org/case/dashboards.html): Redesign of SolarWinds' general dashboarding framework for IT professionals.
- [Log Manager](https://dreamlands.org/case/logmanager.html): SolarWinds log collection and analysis product.
- [Performance Analyzer](https://dreamlands.org/case/perfstack.html): Tool for analyzing timeseries data across heterogeneous IT entities.
- [Capacity Planner](https://dreamlands.org/case/capacity.html): Capacity planning feature for SolarWinds Virtualization Manager.
- [Lovecraftesque](https://dreamlands.org/case/lovecraftesque.html): Rules reference card for the storytelling game Lovecraftesque.

## Side projects

- [dreamlands](https://github.com/breitreiter/dreamlands): A web-based narrative CRPG.
- [nb](https://github.com/breitreiter/nb): AI terminal swiss army knife.
- [imp](https://github.com/breitreiter/imp): A coding harness for your coding harness.
- [UglyPrompt](https://github.com/breitreiter/UglyPrompt): Permissively-licensed modern ReadLine for REPLs.
